name: Flowers
source:
Main character attends high school in an old town. One day he goes to a local musician to buy his first musical instrument. Just one encounter changes the color of his world completely. This is how his modest love story begins.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
